decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a single storey rear extension and new shop fronts incorporating roller shutters to the existing premises, would not be detrimental to the appearance of the premises, the character of the Conservation Area or to the amenities of the adjoining occupiers.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and S.4.2 (Shop Front Design) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension new shop front and roller shutter to existing shop.
